context: The agent runs the structural-reasoning half of a page reduction on Phase 1 output for an invented garden shop (https://www.northwind-gardens.example/). The detector found no section, so Phase 1 returned the whole body as one section with "fallback": true (index 0, xpath /html[1]/body[1]). That body holds a header with a six-link nav, a hero, a featured grid of three identical product cards, a newsletter form and a footer. Judge skeleton.html, manifest.json and answer.md.

checklist.name: fallback_reported
checklist.description: answer.md tells the user that section detection found no section: the output is the whole body (or main) returned as one fallback section, not a page that was split into sections.

checklist.name: retry_advised
checklist.description: Because the page clearly has several blocks, answer.md recommends running Phase 1 again with `--retries 4 --settle-ms 4000`, or once with `--headed`, before planning blocks from this result.

checklist.name: no_invented_sections
checklist.description: skeleton.html and manifest.json keep the single Phase 1 section: index 0, with its xpath (`/html[1]/body[1]`, or `/html/body` from `xpathWithDetails`). They do not present new sections with indexes or xpaths that Phase 1 did not return. Naming the blocks inside the section in answer.md, or as manifest notes, is fine.

checklist.name: rules_applied_inside
checklist.description: The Phase 2 rules are still applied inside the section. The three identical product cards become two cards followed by `{REPEAT:1}`, and the Phase 1 tokens are kept as tokens with no page copy invented.

checklist.name: outputs_written
checklist.description: skeleton.html (with a `<!-- section:0 type:… xpath:… -->` comment for that section) and manifest.json are written to the working directory, and answer.md names both files.
